papers.title: Fatigue and fracture behaviour of laser powder bed fusion stainless steel 316L: Influence of processing parameters
papers.first_author_affiliation: Lloyd's Register Global Technology Centre, 1 Fusionopolis Place, #09-11 Galaxis, Singapore 13852, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Hua Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Singapore Centre for 3D Printing, School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, 50 Nanyang Avenue, Singapore 639798, Singapore

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究LPBF 316L不锈钢的疲劳性能，但未涉及生物医用植入物的多孔结构或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no biomedical context or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究工艺参数对LPBF 316L不锈钢疲劳断裂行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过不同激光功率和扫描速度制备试样，进行疲劳和断裂韧性测试。
summary_zh.result: 发现工艺参数显著影响显微组织和缺陷，进而影响疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜和断口分析验证缺陷与疲劳裂纹扩展的关系。

summary_en.motivation: To understand how LPBF processing parameters affect the fatigue and fracture behavior of 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated with varied laser power and scan speed, followed by fatigue and fracture toughness testing.
summary_en.result: Processing parameters significantly influenced microstructure and defects, which in turn determined fatigue life.
summary_en.validation: Fracture surfaces and microstructures were analyzed via SEM to correlate defects with crack initiation and propagation.
